name: 1st-2nd Grade Mathematics Question Set (Normalized)
description: Focuses on addition, subtraction, basic comparison, shapes, and early word problems.

questions.problem: Marcus has 210 baseball cards. He has 58 more than Carter. How many baseball cards does Carter have?
questions.explanation:
Problem: Marcus has 210 baseball cards. He has 58 more than Carter. How many baseball cards does Carter have?

Approach:
1. This is a mathematical problem requiring subtraction.
2. We can represent this with the formula/equation: 210-58=152.
3. Solving the equation gives the final answer: 152 (baseball cards).

questions.problem: Mrs. Hilt has two pennies, two dimes, and two nickels. Jacob has four pennies, one nickel, and one dime. How much more?

Problem: Mrs. Hilt has two pennies, two dimes, and two nickels. Jacob has four pennies, one nickel, and one dime. How much more?
